mapper.sql: id, create_user_id, create_user_name, create_time, update_user_id, update_user_name, update_time, version, is_deleted, remark, disabled, is_push_mobile, logistics_channel_id, logistics_channel_name, logistics_channel_code, third_supplier_code, third_supplier_name, platform_type, logistics_supplier_id, logistics_supplier_name, third_channel_code, third_channel_name, push_type, dict_platform
mapper.select: select ltcr.id, ltcr.platform_type as platformType, ltcr.logistics_supplier_id as logisticsSupplierId, ltcr.logistics_supplier_name as logisticsSupplierName, ltcr.logistics_channel_id as logisticsChannelId, ltcr.logistics_channel_name as logisticsChannelName, ltcr.logistics_channel_code as logisticsChannelCode, ltcr.third_supplier_code as thirdSupplierCode, ltcr.third_supplier_name as thirdSupplierName, ltcr.third_channel_code as thirdChannelCode, ltcr.third_channel_name as thirdChannelName, ltcr.is_push_mobile as isPushMobile, ltcr.push_type as pushType, ltcr.create_user_name as createUserName, ltcr.disabled as disabled, ltcrd.id as detailId, ltcrd.shop_id as shopId, ltcrd.shop_name as shopName, ltcrd.customer_id as customerId, ltcrd.dict_platform as dictPlatform, ltcrd.mobile as mobile from logistics_third_channel_ref ltcr left join logistics_third_channel_ref_detail ltcrd on ltcr.id = ltcrd.main_id and ltcrd.is_deleted = false where ltcr.is_deleted = false and ltcr.disabled = false and ltcr.platform_type = #{platformType} order by ltcr.create_time desc

select ltcr.id as id, ltcr.platform_type as platformType, ltcr.logistics_channel_id as logisticsChannelId, ltcr.logistics_channel_name as logisticsChannelName, ltcr.logistics_channel_code as logisticsChannelCode, ltcr.disabled as disabled, ltcr.dict_platform as mainDictPlatform from logistics_third_channel_ref ltcr where ltcr.is_deleted = false and ltcr.disabled = false and ltcr.logistics_channel_id = #{channelId} order by ltcr.create_time desc

select * from logistics_third_channel_ref ltcr where ltcr.is_deleted = false and ltcr.disabled = false AND ( (ltcr.dict_platform = #{salePlatform} and ltcr.logistics_channel_id = #{channelId} and ltcr.logistics_supplier_id = #{logisticsSupplierId}) OR (ltcr.dict_platform = #{salePlatform} and ltcr.logistics_channel_id ='all' and ltcr.logistics_supplier_id = #{logisticsSupplierId}) OR (ltcr.dict_platform = #{salePlatform} AND ltcr.logistics_supplier_id = 'all' AND ltcr.logistics_channel_id = 'all') )
